text_block_list.text: ...Grass Wonder ran incredibly, but Spe, you fought bravely too.
If determined, paths exist... or should we forgo [Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe]...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Condition was great, put in all training, gave every ounce of strength running, desu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, Grass-chan passed me and pulled further away. Couldn't catch her at all, desu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...As I am now, even entering 『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』, absolutely no way I could win, desu...
Inside her mind, dream of "Japan's #1 Uma Musume" clouded over―――
Reality of 『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』 challenge hit hard, defeat landing heavier blow than anticipated.

...Understood. Let us pivot strategy.
Targeting domestic titles holds strong merit.

We will observe 『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』 closely.
Valuable reconnaissance for future chance.

We will observe 『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』 closely.
Valuable reconnaissance for future chance.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa... Haa... Haa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Spuuuurt!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Whew~...
(Ring! Ring!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Allo~? Bonjouuuur!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: 『Hello, El. Are you in the middle of training?』

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Just taking break! Tummy rumbling!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: 『Fufu, glad you sound lively.』

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass, congrats on 『Takarazuka Kinen』!
That final stretch was amazing, thrilling, incredible!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So inspiring! Makes El want to run right now, can't sit still!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: 『My, thank you. Honored you think so.』

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, El, everyone—seeing you all run kept my dream alive.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I will repay this debt.
My dream—perfecting my run and claiming the peak.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: 『Whoa! Burning with fighting spirit as always!』

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...El, soon time for you to challenge world's strongest.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』 only 3 months away!
El will get even stronger by then!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And El's dream—prove El is world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: 『...In that spirit, you will surely give everything.』

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Give everything... yeah—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Seeing El off like this, El is touched, inspired, full of passion!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are you really sure you don't want us coming to airport, desu?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! Today weekday, no?
Everyone must study properly!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll study for El-chan too,
and make Japan's races super lively for you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Having classmate challenge world makes even King proud.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to news of your victory.
King will show you exploits that reach France too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, will do my best!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Alright, then... time to go...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Really... got to go now...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...El, still have a little time, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, then, to send you off properly—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What is this~~?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Told you, sending you off~
Look forward and focus, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So this is how we send her off?
Fufu, how delightful!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! Sending her off full power!
Uoooooooh~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Me too! Daaaaa~~~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh~ oh~, getting lively~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait! Running for real?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... El, show us.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Run of one aiming for world's strongest... show us...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...El aims for world's strongest...!
No time for hesitation...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Watch El! Yaaaaaaa~~~~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Left all doubts in Japan.
『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』, El challenges with full strength!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: 『Yes, show world magnificent run.』

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: 『And after that... looking forward to racing that El♪』

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, sí!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Day has arrived. Japanese Umamusume, El Condor Pasa, challenges world's apex.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Cheered on via broadcast, and here in France, voices of 2,000 supporters push her forward.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Can El Condor Pasa achieve historic feat no Japanese Umamusume has accomplished before?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: (...El's dream, prove El world's strongest on this stage...)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Now, Umamusume drawing most attention enters paddock!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
7 starts, 6 wins, one 2nd place!
France's strongest, Montjeu, enters!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: ...Fuu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Montjeu...

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa, know your feats well. After long campaign, here to claim this race too.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: True strength of Japan's Umamusume, show me here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Didn't need to ask, El will show even more...!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: <Let's both have good race.>

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: World's pinnacle race, 『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』... facing world-class Umamusume, and France's strongest, Montjeu...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Stage set. Gave all in prep, bringing full power for dream—becoming world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Will Japan's El Condor Pasa defeat world's best, including Montjeu, and seize victory?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Umamusume leave paddock, heading onto stage of 『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』...!
